name: AlgoAlpha — 7-email Hormozi $100M Leads template (per video retainer + 30 percent lifetime commission)
target: Crypto + trading content creators (YouTube, TradingView authors, Substacks). {company} = channel/brand. {personal_hook} populated by personal_hook_worker.py — only required on step 1.
voice_notes: Hormozi $100M Leads templates verbatim structure. Step 1 = 'Are you open?' + personalised hook (the prospect's most recent video). Step 4 = 'Are you busy?' Problem/Solution. NO apostrophes, em-dashes, quotes, word-hyphens. Required: {company} (greeting falls back to channel name when no personal name is parseable); {personal_hook} on step 1 only. {retainer_quote} + {retainer_math} are derived merges (always present, computed at send time).
offer_notes: Lead offer = a flat per video retainer STACKED on top of the existing 30 percent lifetime commission. The retainer is personalized PER INFLUENCER at send time by sequences/algoalpha_offer.py from prospects.audience_size: 4 USD per 1,000 subscribers per video, rounded to the nearest 50, floor 200 USD, cap 5,000 USD (cap reached ~1.25M), max 4 paid videos per month (bounds monthly exposure; framed in copy as opportunity, e.g. up to 4,200 USD a month). Math favors us: break-even ~0.023 percent of expected views converting; commission only pays on collected revenue. INTERNAL ONLY — the copy states the resulting number as a locked offer and NEVER reveals the rate, the math, or the audience figure next to the quote; we calculate on our end. Quoted through the {retainer_quote} (inline clause) and {retainer_math} (offer paragraph, step 3) merge fields; unknown or sub-10k audiences fall back to range language (200 to 5,000 USD, sized to your channel) that asks for the channel link. Reference points: 50k=200, 100k=400, 250k=1,000, 500k=2,000, 1M=4,000. Proof points held constant: 14.1M TradingView chart adds, 75k paying traders, Editor Choice badge x2.
schedule_doc: delay_days = gap from prior step. 0,2,2,3,4,7,10 = day 0,2,4,7,11,18,28.

variants.subject: a per video retainer for {company}?
variants.body:
Hey {greeting},

{personal_hook}

Are you open to a flat retainer per video, paid whether your audience signs up or not?

Here is the whole offer. You put AlgoAlpha in your videos. We pay you {retainer_quote}. The cash is yours up front, win or lose. On top of it you keep 30 percent lifetime commission on every paid signup you send, every month they stay.

We are AlgoAlpha. 14.1 million chart adds on TradingView, 75,000 paying traders, Editor Choice badge twice. So the product converts, which is what makes the commission stack on top of the retainer.

Does it make sense to hop on a quick 15 minute call to lock your rate and your link?

Just hit reply with your channel link.

P.s. reply no if not interested.

variants.subject: the retainer is paid even if nobody signs up
variants.body:
Hey {greeting},

Was checking out {company} and saw your audience already trades, which is exactly who this pays on.

The part most creators miss: the retainer is guaranteed. We pay you {retainer_quote} whether a single viewer signs up or not, so there is zero performance risk on your side. Then the 30 percent lifetime commission rides on top for the ones who do sign up, every month they stay. On top of both you get free lifetime VIP and one custom branded indicator. Five partner slots open this quarter.

Worth 15 minutes to set your rate and your link?

variants.subject: 14k in retainer before any commission, one creator
variants.body:
Hey {greeting},

What this actually pays out.

{retainer_math}

Top creator partner last quarter, a channel in the 250k to 1M range, posted 4 videos and banked 14,000 USD in retainer before a single signup cleared. Then the commission stacked on top. Average paid signup spends 247 USD in year one, so your 30 percent is about 74 USD per signup per year, lifetime.

Same math runs for {company} the moment your link is live.

variants.subject: one off sponsor money vs retainer plus commission
variants.body:
Hey {greeting},

Me again, considering this is the 4th email, I am sure you are busy.

Problem: a one off sponsorship pays you once and then the money stops, and you carry all the risk if it does not convert.

Solution: we pay a retainer per video up front, so you are paid like a sponsorship but with no conversion risk, and then the 30 percent lifetime commission keeps paying every month a subscriber stays. The same audience you would rent to a sponsor once, you get paid for up front and then keep collecting on, month after month.

15 minutes and I set your rate and your link. Let me know what time works.

variants.subject: {company}, retainer plus 30 percent, yes or no
variants.body:
Hey {greeting},

If we paid {company} {retainer_quote}, charged you nothing upfront or monthly, added 30 percent lifetime commission on every signup, and handed your audience a custom branded indicator for free, would you say yes?

A clear yes or no both work.

variants.subject: free mockup, and the retainer stands
variants.body:
Hey {greeting},

Whether {company} takes the retainer or not, here is a free thing.

I will send a one page mockup of the custom indicator we would build and brand for your audience. Hit reply and I send it within 48 hours.

No call after. The retainer and the 30 percent commission stay open whenever you want them.

variants.subject: closing the retainer slot for {company}
variants.body:
Hey {greeting},

Closing your partner slot at AlgoAlpha today since the five quarterly seats fill this week. The per video retainer and the 30 percent lifetime commission go with the slot.

If the timing is off, I get it. If the offer is off, tell me what would land. Otherwise I will not write again.
